reviews.text:
Edit : unfortunately transferring care to another clinic as they have not been responsive at all with travel certification needs despite being a patient for 3+ years. Would have loved to stay here

So happy we found this place, always a great experience! Dr Bradshaw is an extremely kind provider and will patiently answer all of my questions. We always leave very happy and satisfied!
Dr. Greco is the best!!!!
Stellar vet service. The vets and techs are so caring and they always have last minute appointments available. It’s easy, convenient, and our dog loves going. Couldn’t recommend more

I've been taking my cat, Bean, to this practice over the years and always have the best possible experience. The staff and the vets are so friendly, helpful, kind, and knowledgeable. Bean had his dental surgery here twice, and the vets did a great job with the monitoring, anesthesia, extractions/cleaning, and aftercare. I would highly recommend this practice to anyone!

Everyone is so attentive and kind and knowledgeable, from the front desk to the vet techs to the vets. There are so many vets at this practice which means I can often get appointments on short notice. Every vet I've worked with has been amazing. And such a nice space! 100/10 recommend :) and my cat bagheera agrees.
They are so caring of our pets, and even if our primary veterinary doctor is not available, the others who work there are just as amazing!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review. Our team really appreciates it!

We've been bringing our babies to WCV since the office was over on 10th Avenue/22nd Street.

We've seen multiple doctors, from Dr. Farber to Dr. Pagano, Dr. Magasweran, Dr. Horan, Dr. Greco, Dr. Canales, and finally, our utterly beloved and soon-to-depart Dr. Chen. [insert tear emoji here].

With all of them, across the board, our cats AND we received thoughtful, skillful care, always with extraordinary emotional intelligence and elite communication.

We've seen three cats leave us with West Chelsea Vet; in each case the tenderness and empathy made the worst time as tolerable as it could be. (Not tolerable, but...better).

And now we entrust Gibson and Poppy to them, knowing that even with Dr. Chen's departure [insert ANOTHER tear emoji], whoever sees after our beloved pets next will provide the same high level of care. It is SUCH a relief to have this as a certainty.

I'll also say that the front desk staff is similarly professional, warm, and caring; patiently answering what are surely repetitious questions with grace.

For as long as we are in New York City--for we will always have cats--West Chelsea Veterinary is where they will receive their care.

Thank you.

I have been with West Chelsea for many years and I always know I am getting trustworthy help for my kids!!

I’m so thankful for the great care team!!

Dr. Gabriela Canales is a total rockstar! She always takes the best care of my cat, Mike, and I trust her completely. The entire staff is fabulous—kind, welcoming, and they truly care. Mike gives Dr. Canales and the whole team 5-star meows! 🐾😸

As a first-time dog owner, I was naturally nervous and had a lot of questions. From the moment we walked in, the entire team treated both me and Jace with kindness, patience, and compassion. They took the time to explain everything in a way that made me feel comfortable and confident in the care Jace was receiving. Seeing him doing so much better now is such a blessing, and I'm incredibly grateful for the excellent care they provided. I couldn't have asked for a better veterinary team, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for people who truly care about their pets.

Dr. Greco was incredible. He took the time to go over each and every one of my concerns with my dog. There was no rush, and excellent bed-side demeanor. He immediately came up with solutions to help her thrive. Highly Recommend.
Nice, clean office. The staff is warm, caring and helpful. They don’t try to push expensive procedures on you and your fur baby un necessarily.
Very kind, knowledgeable, and well trained staff.
Great stuff, compassionate and professional. Dr. Check up thorough. Great veterinary service.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

I was looking at several of the negative reviews here. This has not been my experience at West Chelsea Vet. I’ve been taking my little ones there for 15 years now. I’ve found the vets, vet techs and front desk staff to be fantastic every single visit. They cared for my 15 year old cat until the very end. They provided exceptional care over the course of 7 years for my diabetic cat. I have nothing but positive things to say about WCV.
Dr. Price was fantastic! Super knowledgable and friendly and answered all of my questions. The staff and nurses were fantastic too! Will probably make my primary vet going forward.

The best vets i ever had. Been treating my pugs since the early 90's. On my 6th.  All my pugs are special needs adoptions and they are treated like royalty at west chelsea. They were as excited as i was to get my newset rescue pug domino!

I was able to get a same day appointment for my kitty, who they hadn't seen before, when he had a medical event. They were so kind, and my cat was immediately at ease. I've switched vets now based on the experience, and my cat sitter's recommendation. Really appreciated the care and support from Dr. Harer and Eva the Vet Tech. They even helped with the insurance forms - which is a HUGE help!
Excellent vets and follow up, easy to make appointments and a very well run system.

We really like both the vet and nurse that we met with. They were both very caring and kind, and the vet took time to understand our concerns and answer questions. She seemed very knowledgeable and went above and beyond when diagnosing the problem and providing treatment options. We were provided with a very detailed estimate prior to treatment so there were no surprises, and the cost was in line with other vets we have been too. We will definitely be back to see her when we are New York and have any veterinary needs.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

We have seen WVC for my two babies for almost 4 years. Every time the WVC team provides the best service to my babies.
Especially this past Saturday, we walked in at 8am after Robin suffered a tooth and gum injury from an accident. The WVC team was incredibly accommodating and managed to fit us in to see Dr. Price on short notice.

Dr. Price provided thoughtful and professional guidance on Robin’s condition and promptly arranged blood work, which ultimately saved us valuable time for the follow-up procedures at AMC.

We’re truly grateful for the team’s efficiency, compassion, and support during such a stressful situation. Thank you again for taking such good care of Robin.
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Be careful, they marked up meds 200% .

My sweet cat was not feeling well, and I just moved so I didn't know where to get really loving and supportive kitty care. I was also unable to take him in myself. My partner brought him in, and he was seen by Dr. Canales. I was on speakerphone as she discussed options, pricing, and follow up. Even though I couldn't be there, I felt so comforted and grateful that we chose this veterinary office. I am so pleased with her attention to detail, how kind and informative she is, and I'm grateful to have found the right place for both of my boys. I hope never to have an emergency situation again. I do look forward to continuing with follow up and preventative medical care.
Thank you so much, Dr. Canales. You are a gem.
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Responsible and experienced doctors, accommodating staffs, short response time, and they handle my dog with great care—my dog doesn’t think of this place as a vet, more like daycare with amazing human friends who always give him all the attention he needs

The whole staff is great! Very attentive, knowledgeable and caring. Clear and effective communicators. I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Price! She is so Sweet towards my cat bijou. She’s understanding with how my cat is feeling and treats her like bijou could be her own pet and it’s just really comforting to see that. There are cheaper, veterinarian offices in the city but I continue to come to West Chelsea vet because of the excellent medical care they provide and the genuineness in the interactions I’ve had with the staff there. Thank you so much!
Very personal customized and thorough service. I totally trust them with the care of my dogs. Exceptional care it’s the best place for vetinary care in all of NY. I highly recommend them!👍
Dr. Canales is the best! Our dog has a lot of allergy issues, and they always remember and accommodate her needs. Highly recommended for anyone with pets in the area!
My experience with WCV has always been the best possible.  Caring for my two dogs and their cat brother are Dr Farber and Dr Gayer.  I trust and recommend WCV
Thanks so much for the review!
West Chelsea Veterinary provides superior care and customer service for my beautiful Max and Phoebe. Prompt and efficient appointment scheduling - best doctors and staff. Highly recommend!

My dog has 30% renal function and is on renal support special diet food.  My vet provided me a prescription for order online but I ran out without enough to wait on delivery.  Looking for a local source and West Chelsea has it but will not sell it to me without a full veterinary visit plus $85 to do a blood pressure reading.   The six pound bag is $40.   They are holding it hostage for $250 surcharge saying they will not recognize my veterinary’s prescription, the same one I uploaded to purchase online. Really lacks empathy and nothing more than greedy.   Avoid greedy veterinaries as care is not their first priority.  I guess that is Manhattan.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Carol!

I used to go to the Westside vet center on 83rd, moved to Chelsea and tried taking my cat here. I arrived 10 minutes early for my appointment as instructed, but we sat in the waiting room for about 45-50 minutes. At westside vet I never waited longer than 5-10 minutes. The doctor was great when we got in there, but very much treated it as a job. At westside they used to pet my cat and be excited to see him, much less of that here. They gave up on attempting to draw his labs. The prices were much higher also than Westside vet. If I had taken the subway up to 83rd and back I would have spent less time, less money, and been happier with the experience. They seem very capable here, and probably great for emergencies, but it wasn't for me. Also, if anyone is considering a dental cleaning, a cat dental cleaning and grooming under sedation here costs about $3,500. This is 4x more than his previous vet.

This is a good vet but as others have stated, expensive.
I don’t recommend nail trims there. I recently got my dogs nail trim there and it was $60. I asked how that could be $60, and they stated there was a $20 fee to see a technician and $39 for the nails. This was a 5 minute appointment. They should remove random fees as it’s loses customer trust
